1.explanation:
1. table/index.en-us.md & table/index.md: these are the core documentation pages for the Table component and describe the API and built-in features (including sorting). Reviewing them shows the intended behavior and CSS classes used for sorters.
2. table/demo/filter&sort.md: this example page reproduces the exact scenario (sorting icons in action), so it’s essential to see how the icons are rendered in a live demo.
3. table/adaptor/index.jsx: contains the rendering logic for sortable headers and injects the icon elements and relevant class names; you’d need to inspect or modify this to add the cursor style.
4. table/theme/index.jsx: holds the default styling for Table, including any CSS applied to sort icons or header cells. This is where you would add or override `cursor: pointer` for the sorter icons to fix the issue.
1.bug_scenario: The bug occurs in the Table component’s sortable column headers. In the examples (e.g. ‘排序与过滤’/‘filter&sort’ demo), when you hover over the up/down sort icons next to the column title (Id ↑↓), the mouse cursor remains the default arrow instead of changing to a pointer. Users don’t get the clickable affordance on those sort controls.
